title: Cross-functional Reliability Commitment Passport & Initiative Ledger
creator: Marisol Ortega
description:
Goal: Create a single, lightweight "passport" artifact for each reliability initiative that documents SLI targets, SLOs, error-budget allocations and transfer rules, primary/secondary owners, rollback criteria, telemetry links, and quarterly review cadence. The passport will be surfaced in the Initiative Ledger (a canonical index) and integrated into the Console's initiative view so stakeholders can quickly assess commitments and who to contact during an SLI incident.

Scope:
- Define a passport schema (human-readable + machine-friendly fields) for product, engineering, and SRE use.
- Build a small editor UI in the Console to create/update passports and link them to initiatives/OKRs.
- Add backend storage and badges for 'At-Risk' based on live SLI burn rate.
- Provide onboarding templates for common initiative types (throughput, latency, availability, correctness).

Out of scope for this ticket: automatic policy enforcement for transfers (follow-up), long-term historical ledger analytics (separate project).
acceptance_criteria: Passport schema approved by SRE, PM, and Legal (contains required fields and non-sensitive defaults)
Console UI: create, edit, and view passport attached to an initiative
Backend: passports persisted and surfaced in initiative API with stable key
At-Risk badge appears when 30-day error-budget burn > 60% and SLI deviation > threshold
Links to SLI dashboards and runbook can be stored as canonical URLs in the passport
decisions: Schema will be YAML-friendly to simplify Confluence/Drive exports and keep editor portable
Initial SLI burn heuristic: 30-day burn rate, with manual override by owners
Deploy feature behind feature flag and enable for pilot teams only (Platform + Payments) in the first quarter
